voice.searchph: Search the map: components, tokens, patterns
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, laid out level by level. Some blocks hide things.
voice.lede.worlds: One cartridge, many worlds. In this one an 8-bit land sits under every page - mountains, hills, trees and a strip of ground - and an explorer and a black cat walk along it.
voice.lede.typography: Jersey 15 sets the titles - tall, game-poster pixels; Pixelify Sans carries the reading, a pixel face drawn to be read in paragraphs; Tiny5 is for labels and VT323 for code.
voice.lede.colour: Sky, cream and brick by day; deep night and coin gold after dark. Every text colour still clears 4.5:1 against its ground.
voice.lede.spacing: Everything snaps to a 4px grid, the way sprites sit on tiles. Same steps as Studio, laid out in blocks.
voice.lede.radius: No curves here: corners step. Where the browser can cut a notch they notch; where it cannot they stay square.
voice.lede.elevation: Height is a hard shadow, offset down and right, never a blur. A pressed button sinks into its own shadow.
voice.lede.motion: Motion moves in frames, not tweens - steps(), not curves. Short and snappy, and it stops for reduced motion.
voice.lede.icons: Icons drawn on a 24-pixel grid, square pixel by square pixel: pixelarticons, mapped name for name.
voice.lede.button: A block that pushes in. Pressed, it sinks into its shadow; released, it springs back up a frame at a time.
voice.lede.voice: Short, cheerful, a little arcade. Titles count levels; buttons say what happens. Still never a riddle where a label is needed.
voice.lede.404: Game over - this page is not on the map. Search, or the start screen, gets things moving again.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: Jersey 15: tall, narrow pixel capitals and lowercase, like a title screen.
voice.type.sans.note: Pixelify Sans: pixel-built but open and even, for long reading.
voice.type.em.note: Jersey 15 again, in the accent colour instead of italics.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.type.label.note: Tiny5: small square capitals for labels, tags and table heads.
voice.type.mono.note: VT323: a terminal face, set a size up so code reads clearly.
voice.lede.chip: Inventory slots: a square of cream with a dark edge and a shadow under it. Picked, it presses in and turns brick red.
voice.lede.badge: Silkscreen caps in a 2px frame. A live dot blinks in two frames, the way status lights did.
voice.lede.card: A cream block with a dark outline and a hard shadow. Clickable ones hop up and left a step under the pointer.
voice.lede.input: An inset well with a block caret. Focus draws a coin-gold ring outside the outline - never a glow.
voice.lede.checkbox: A square box with a pixel tick drawn on a 12-pixel grid. Ticked, a small star blips out of it.
voice.lede.switch: A block on a rail: off sits left on cream, on slides right in three frames and the rail turns brick red.
voice.lede.slider: A segmented track with a coin for a thumb. The filled part counts up in red.
voice.lede.tabs: Folder tabs. The open one joins its page and carries a pointer in front of its name.
voice.lede.accordion: A heading that opens in two frames; what it holds hangs from a gold rule.
voice.lede.dialog: A dialogue box from a role-playing game: a double frame, a blinking arrow in the corner, a dithered dark behind.
voice.lede.tooltip: A speech bubble with a stepped tail, in the rounder pixel face.
voice.lede.toast: A dialogue box whose words type out a letter at a time - the whole sentence is announced at once.
voice.lede.progress: A health bar: segments fill in steps inside a dark frame.
voice.lede.spinner: A coin that flips in four frames.
voice.lede.skeleton: A dither pattern that shimmers in steps while content loads.
voice.lede.avatar: Square, outlined, and pixelated when scaled.
voice.lede.link: A dotted underline; under the pointer the word lights up in coin gold.
voice.lede.menu: A box with a hard shadow; the item in focus wears a pointer.
voice.lede.morph: Save game: the button becomes a health bar that fills, then a gold Saved, then the slot it saved to.
